scientific_integrity: Global unimodality and stability proved analytically; exact rational bounds certify displayed optimizer interval. Sources of probabilistic limit formulas clearly attributed. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes the already established Gaussian endpoint variance, not a new CLT/MDP/LIL.
The 2018 paper already plots the qualitative interior peak; novelty is limited to unique global optimizer and exact curvature.
No moving-parameter asymptotics are claimed; root decimals are approximations.
Equivalent prior calculations under unrelated terminology may exist.
title: Unique optimal sampling density and quadratic stability of random-LCM fluctuations
